_comment: Merge into your Claude Desktop config, then fully quit and relaunch Desktop (closing the window is not enough). Location: macOS ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json, Windows %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json. This points at agentgateway on :3111, never at the backend on :8000 — a direct connection works but is invisible to the audit log. Claude Desktop's config format does not accept a plain remote 'type: http' entry, so it uses the mcp-remote bridge (needs Node/npx on PATH). Start everything first with: python scripts/dev.py all
